tax.text: Dean opposes large tax cuts for the wealthy and backs public investment in services like education and health care.
tax.quote: She opposes massive tax cuts for the wealthy –– especially when they come at the expense of the American people.

wages.text: Dean, a co-sponsor of the Raise the Wage Act, says the federal minimum wage should rise from $7.25.
wages.quote: I have long believed that the $7.25 minimum wage is inadequate

trade.text: Dean supports fair, targeted tariffs against bad actors like China but warns that broad, erratic tariffs act as a tax on families and risk a harmful trade war.
trade.quote: We need to craft our tariffs and trade regulations so that first and foremost they are fair to American businesses and workers.

debt.text: Dean says she works to protect and expand Medicare and Social Security.
debt.quote: She backs ACA expansion, permanent premium subsidies, protection for pre-existing conditions, lower prescription drug costs, and efforts to protect and expand Medicare and Social Security.

schools.text: Dean's education platform focuses on affordable public education for all with no support for vouchers or school choice.
schools.quote: Rep. Dean supports high-quality, equitable, affordable education for all.

safety.text: Dean backs police accountability measures and alternatives to incarceration such as drug and veterans courts.
safety.quote: mandates reporting of police use of force, prohibits racial and religious profiling, bans chokeholds, and mandates use of police body cameras

immigration.text: Dean supports a strong legal immigration system and humane treatment of those seeking citizenship.
immigration.quote: Madeleine supports a strong legal immigration system and humane treatment for anyone seeking citizenship.

guns.text: Dean calls gun violence a public health crisis and has championed universal background checks and related restrictions.
guns.quote: Gun violence rates in America are hundreds of times higher than in other industrialized countries

abortion.text: Dean calls reproductive health a fundamental right and vows to protect against attacks on Roe v. Wade.
abortion.quote: She believes safe, accessible, quality reproductive health is a fundamental right and need of our communities.

cannabis.text: Dean says it is past time to legalize marijuana and expunge past nonviolent marijuana convictions.
cannabis.quote: It's past time to legalize marijuana, release those behind bars for nonviolent marijuana convictions, and expunge past marijuana convictions.

health.text: Dean defends the Affordable Care Act and Medicaid expansion and supports universal, affordable health care.
health.quote: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) and Medicaid expansion have meant health coverage for tens of millions of Americans

energy.text: Dean backs investments in renewable energy and rejoining global climate agreements to cut greenhouse gas emissions.
energy.quote: Rep. Dean supports legislation to boost America's investments in renewable energy, fund green infrastructure, and reengage in global agreements to combat climate change.

voting.text: Dean cosponsored the For the People Act to expand voting opportunities and opposes state voter-suppression efforts.
voting.quote: H.R. 1 would expand opportunities for voting, tamp down on dark money, fight back against gerrymandering, and tighten ethics rules for government employees.

tax.text: Stuski campaigns on limited government and reducing the tax burden on homeowners, pledging to fight inflationary spending and help families get ahead.
tax.quote: Fight inflationary spending, support small businesses, and make it easier for families to get ahead.

safety.text: Stuski says she will support police and prosecute violent crime to protect neighborhoods and schools.
safety.quote: Back law enforcement, prosecute violent crime, and protect neighborhoods and our local schools.
